general.title: General
general.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for this browser. Stored locally, not on the server.

deployment.title: Deployment and auth
deployment.localTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
deployment.authenticatedPublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
deployment.authenticatedPrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.

censorLogs.title: Censor username in logs
censorLogs.description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.

backupRetention.title: Backup retention
backupRetention.description: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.

feedback.title: AI feedback sharing
feedback.description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
feedback.promptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
feedback.denyDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Control how your account appears in the sidebar and other board surfaces.
profile.selectCompanyBeforeUpload: Select a company before uploading a profile avatar.
profile.uploadHintStored: Stored in Paperclip file storage for {{company}}.
profile.uploadHintSelectCompany: Select a company to upload an avatar into Paperclip storage.
profile.clickAvatarHint: Click the avatar to upload a new image.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown in the sidebar account footer and comment author surfaces.
profile.emailHint: Email is managed by your auth session and is read-only here.

instance.title: Scheduler Heartbeats
instance.description: Agents with a timer heartbeat enabled across all of your companies.
instance.disableManyFailed_one: Failed to disable {{count}} of {{total}} timer heartbeats. First error: {{detail}}
instance.disableManyFailed_other: Failed to disable {{count}} of {{total}} timer heartbeats. First error: {{detail}}
instance.confirmDisableAll_one: Disable timer heartbeats for all {{count}} enabled agent?
instance.confirmDisableAll_other: Disable timer heartbeats for all {{count}} enabled agents?
instance.empty: No scheduler heartbeats match the current criteria.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
experimental.lookbackInvalid: Lookback hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720.
experimental.warningTitle: Experimental features may break at any time.
experimental.warningBody: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.

recoveryDialog.title: Confirm auto-recovery
recoveryDialog.tasksMatch_one: {{count}} recovery task match the last {{hours}} hours.
recoveryDialog.tasksMatch_other: {{count}} recovery tasks match the last {{hours}} hours.
recoveryDialog.empty: No recovery tasks would be created right now. Auto-recovery can still run for future liveness incidents in this window.
recoveryDialog.skippedOutsideLookback_one: {{count}} current finding is outside the configured lookback and will not be touched.
recoveryDialog.skippedOutsideLookback_other: {{count}} current findings are outside the configured lookback and will not be touched.

worktreeRun.title: Run tasks in this worktree
worktreeRun.description: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. By default it does not execute agent runs; tasks stay queued so previews never self-run work. Turn this on to let the heartbeat scheduler execute runs here. This setting only affects this worktree instance and is ignored outside a worktree.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
cases.note: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

environments.title: Enable Environments
environments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

builtInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
builtInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

fileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
fileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

externalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
externalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

goalsSidebar.title: Goals Sidebar Link
goalsSidebar.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
goalsSidebar.ariaLabel: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting

isolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
isolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

conferenceRoom.title: Conference Room Chat
conferenceRoom.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
conferenceRoom.ariaLabel: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

planDecomposition.title: Task Plan Decomposition Panel
planDecomposition.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
planDecomposition.ariaLabel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

taskWatchdogs.title: Task Watchdogs
taskWatchdogs.description: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.

cloudSync.title: Cloud Sync
cloudSync.description: Show local Paperclip Cloud upstream connection, preview, push, retry, and activation review surfaces. Saved connections and run history are preserved when this is disabled.

serverInfo.title: Server Info Debug View
serverInfo.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
serverInfo.ariaLabel: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting

autoRestart.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestart.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

autoRecovery.title: Auto-Create Recovery Tasks
autoRecovery.description: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.
